delivery.title: Faahfaahinta gaarsiinta - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Pass" halkan waxa ay ka dhigan tahay oo kaliya in server-kii bartilmaameedku uu soo celiyay heerka HTTP 2xx - ma xaqiijiso nidaamka helista sida dhabta ah loo kaydiyay ama loo farsameeyay hogaanka. Ka hubi hay'adda jawaabta ee sare waxa ay run ahaantii tidhi; haddii ay bannaan tahay ama kaliya qirasho, nidaamkaas waxaa laga yaabaa inuu helo codsiga laakiin diidaya ama iska indhatiraya culeyska gudaha (magacyada goobta qaldan/qaabka API ga, meel looga baahan yahay dhinaceeda oo culeyskan uusan ku jirin, iwm).

push.title: Webhooks Shabakadda ee ka baxa - Riix Hogaaminta & Cusboonaysiinta
push.intro: Si buuxda loo beddeli karo halkii webhook : JSON , Foom (x-www-form-urlencoded), ama template jirkaaga gaarka ah oo leh <fieldkey></fieldkey> meeleeyayaasha (tusaale <example></example> ) - wuxuu u shaqeeyaa sida buuxinta amarka cURL hal mar.
push.curlHelp: Ku dhaji tusaalaha codsiga dukumeentigooda API ama Postman ayaa ku siinaya (oo wata xog dhab ah ama muunad). URL , habka iyo madax-madaxeedyada ayaa loo koobiyeeyay sidiisii, fure kasta oo jidhka ku jira ayaa hoos ku taxan si aad u dooran karto goobta CRM ee buuxinaysa hogaanka kasta.
push.curlPrompt: Ma leedahay cURL macmiilka? <action>Ka soo deji cURL</action> si tan loo buuxiyo oo khariidad goobaha si toos ah.
push.urlVariables: URL waxa uu ka koobnaan karaa doorsoomayaal, tusaale ahaan <urlexample></urlexample> .
push.headersInvalid: Madaxdu waa inay ahaadaan kuwo sax ah JSON , tusaale {{example}}
push.authTitle: Xaqiijinta (sida Leadrat u galo API gooda)
push.modeSame: U dir dhacdo kasta isla URL
push.modeCreateUpdate: Samee rikoorka hal mar, ka dibna cusbooneysii isla rikoorkaas (wax nuqul ah kama jiraan dhinacooda)
push.responseIdHint: Halka ID ku jiro jawaabtooda JSON ee codsiga abuurista. Waxaa loo kaydiyay hogaankiiba <externalid></externalid> .
push.retriesHint: Wixii wakhti ah, khaladaadka HTTP 429 iyo 5xx - ka dib 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h.
push.updateBody: Cusbooneysii jirka (madhan = la mid ah abuurista)
push.howFilled: Sida qiyamka loo buuxiyo: webhook -kan ayaa dib loogu isticmaalay hogaan kasta - Leadrat ma soo diro tusaale taagan, waxay soo dirtaa riixis cusub mar kasta oo dhacdo la doortay ay dhacdo, oo leh qiyamka rasaasta hadda.
push.howFilledStandard: JSON / Foomka si toos ah ugu dara goob kasta oo hogaanka ku taal - ma jiraan wax la dejiyo.
push.howFilledCustom: Caadiyan - u qor guddiga codsigaaga oo ku rid meel kasta; Mid walba waxa lagu beddelanayaa qiimihii rasaasta ka hor inta aan la dirin. Guji doorsoomaha hoose si aad u geliso
push.rawTemplate: Qaabka Jirka (Ceyriin) - si toos ah wax uga beddel ama geli doorsoomayaasha
push.preview: Horudhac - waxa run ahaantii la diri doono (tusaale hogaanka)
push.previewEmpty: (kor ku qor template jirka si aad u aragto horudhac)
push.empty: Weli ma jiraan webhooks oo la habeeyey.
push.deleteConfirm: Tirtir webhook " {{name}} "? Tan lama celin karo.

api.title: API kaaga - Galka Laba-Wadad ee Nidaam Kasta
api.intro: Nidaam kasta oo leh furahaaga API wuxuu abuuri karaa, akhrin karaa oo cusboonaysiin karaa tilmaamaha wuxuuna ku biiri karaa dhacdooyinka hogaaminta. U dir furaha <hdr></hdr> madaxa, sida <bearer></bearer> , ama (haddii qalabku aanu dejin karin madaxyada) sidii <query></query> . Xaddid: {{limit}} codsiyada daqiiqadii
api.noPermission: Kaliya qof haysta oggolaanshaha Maamulida Settings ayaa arki kara furaha API .
api.shownOnce: Nuqul kan furaha hadda oo ku kaydi meel nabdoon - amniga waxa la tusay hal mar oo keliya. Haddii ay luntay, soo saar mid cusub.
api.regenerateConfirm: Samee furaha API cusub? Furaha hadda ayaa isla markiiba joojinaya shaqada nidaam kasta oo isticmaalaya.
api.openApiHint: Soo rar faahfaahinta OpenAPI ee Postman , Zapier , Samee ama n8n si aad u hesho meel kasta oo dhamaadka diyaar u ah in la isticmaalo.
